name: ppt-minimal-skill-v7
description: v7 of the teaching-deck builder: EVERY bullet is an arrow chain (Concept -> mechanism -> meaning, Effect <- cause), each bullet kept to one line (overflow goes to the next bullet), the class title slide and Thank you slide, per-topic title fonts, colors and title bullets (centered start, left continued, gold oval for key titles, black topic label for sub-parts), Figure captions under the image, continuous Times New Roman 18 pt symbol lines and no 'Definition:' subtitles. Use when 'v7' or all-arrow class decks are asked for. Skills: `ppt-minimal-skill-v7`.
